{{Quote|Squadron C-3, watch your port-zenith flank. There's a blister on that Frigate that could be a cluster trap.|Grand Admiral Thrawn during the Raid on Sarka|<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />}}
'''Squadron C-3''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] that fought for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the [[Raid on Sarka]]. During the battle, the squadron attacked a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that was armed with a [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster trap]]. Thrawn recognized the weapon and ordered the squadron to move away from the figate before the trap detonated, saving all but one of the interceptors.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />
